title: Reverse engineering achieved propulsion and beamed power

tellings.quote: I think enough to have propulsion um, and beamed power so that you don't necessarily have to have an onboard power source for these devices.

plain: Matthew Brown, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, says US efforts to copy recovered craft by taking them apart have learned enough to make propulsion work. He adds they have learned to beam power to these devices, so they do not need to carry their own power source. If true, it would mean the US has working technology taken from non-human craft.
